_: The media room (media.html). Newest first. To add a film: append an entry, then `python3 add_media.py <slug>` (encodes HLS 1080 + 720, a poster and a 12 s silent teaser into assets/film/<slug>), then `python3 build_media.py` and build_seo. src is relative to the NEW YORKERS BY MLOW folder. poster_t is the poster frame in seconds; teaser is four [start, end] cuts of about three seconds each, or [] for no teaser. link is the page the film belongs to. No dates and no totals in any copy.

films.title: CLOUDS AND DIRT
films.label: CLOUDS AND DIRT, a skate film through the tower for Gary Vaynerchuk, by MLow
films.blurb: Twenty five floors built for Gary Vaynerchuk, skated top to bottom by twenty five unlikely riders: a yellow cab out of the lobby, the Kid in the dirt, the Lucky Black Cat over the VeeCon stage, a panda in the Spectacular vault, a worm on Burn Island, a pig that flips the gym at half court. Every floor plays its own song, every floor's trick goes off on the beat, and all twenty five play at once before the Kid lands on the roof among the words in the sky.
films.src: CLOUDS AND DIRT HYPE FILM 2026-10-22/out/CLOUDS AND DIRT v1.mp4

films.title: One day in New York
films.label: One day in New York, a NEW YORKERS film by MLow
films.blurb: One day in the city, told by the New Yorkers in the collection: first light on the bridge, the train, the block, the music, a quiet moment, the Cyclone's first drop. Then the camera pulls back through the whole census until it becomes the seal. Scored to MLow's song Runway In My Mind.
